properties.name: buttonPlayStop
properties.title: Play / Stop Button
properties.description: The GPIO number (BCM) of a push button wired between that pin and ground. Pressing it stops playback, and pressing it again resumes. Leave it empty if there is no such button. Not a pin the panel uses (the app says which, if you choose one). Changes apply within a few seconds.

properties.name: buttonNext
properties.title: Next Button
properties.description: The GPIO number (BCM) of a push button wired between that pin and ground. Pressing it shows the next page of the playlist. Leave it empty if there is no such button.

properties.name: buttonStop
properties.title: Stop Button
properties.description: The GPIO number (BCM) of a push button wired between that pin and ground, for a button that only stops playback (resume it with the play/stop button or in the web app). Leave it empty if there is no such button.
